fallacy_scan.finding: Per-metric, per-repeat and group-macro errors exposed; pooled improvements may differ from group behavior.
Historical operational keys and source-code proxies are not independent physical recipes, batches or regions.
Official workbook is a selected historical collection; complete-case replay is more selected still.
Measured outcomes never enter design predictors; selection on availability can still distort associations.
Threshold pass/fail prevalence and false-pass counts reported; trivial thresholds cannot establish skill.
New variants need concurrent freshly prepared controls; historical extremes cannot prove improvement.
Missing labels and flagged inputs retained in audit; complete-case replay scope explicitly limited.
All 81 configurations, repeats and negatives published. Post-hoc winner is exploratory; no uncorrected significance claims.
Protocol/configurations frozen before execution. All later analyses are diagnostics or exploratory; new experiments require new output directories.
Multi-task correlations, surrogate changes and retrospective query counts are not causal material or laboratory gains.
Design-only pre-test features; no causal attribution or post-test predictors.

verdict_scope: Reproducible computation and internal data separation only, not material validity or engineering performance.
